Name: UpdateVoucherBook
Content:
declare @$stt_rec_gs varchar(13)
if charindex(',', rtrim(@ma_ct_gs)) = 0 and isnull(@so_ct_gs, '') <> '' and @ngay_ct_gs is not null begin
  declare @c$ varchar(32), @q nvarchar(4000), @partition varchar(32), @$voucherNumberLength int

  select @c$ = c$ from dmct9 where ma_ct = rtrim(@ma_ct_gs)
  select @q = 'select top 1 @$stt_rec_gs = stt_rec from ' + @c$ + case when right(@c$, 1) = '0' then '' else '000000' end + ' where rtrim(ltrim(so_ct)) = rtrim(ltrim(@so_ct_gs)) and ngay_ct = @ngay_ct_gs and status <> ''*'''
  exec sp_executesql @q, N'@so_ct_gs varchar(12), @ngay_ct_gs smalldatetime, @$stt_rec_gs varchar(13) output', @so_ct_gs, @ngay_ct_gs, @$stt_rec_gs output

  if isnull(@$stt_rec_gs, '') <> '' begin
    select @partition = case when right(@c$, 1) = '0' then right(@c$, len(@c$) - 1) else right(@c$, 3) + convert(varchar(6), @ngay_ct_gs, 112) end

    select @q = 'if not exists(select 1 from h' + @partition  + ' where stt_rec = @$stt_rec_gs and stt_rec_hd0 = @stt_rec) insert into h' + @partition  + '(stt_rec, ngay_ct, stt_rec_hd0, ngay_hd0, status0) select @$stt_rec_gs, @ngay_ct_gs, @stt_rec, @ngay_ct, @status'
    exec sp_executesql @q, N'@stt_rec varchar(13), @$stt_rec_gs varchar(13), @ngay_ct smalldatetime, @ngay_ct_gs smalldatetime, @status char(1)', @stt_rec, @$stt_rec_gs, @ngay_ct, @ngay_ct_gs, @status

    select @$voucherNumberLength = character_maximum_length from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where table_name = 'wrkcolumns' and column_name = 'so_ct'
    select @so_ct_gs = dbo.ff_PadL(@so_ct_gs, @$voucherNumberLength), @tt_gs = '2', @status = '4'
    update &MasterTable; set status = '4', tt_gs = '2', stt_rec_gs = @$stt_rec_gs, so_ct_gs = @so_ct_gs where stt_rec = @stt_rec
    update @@inquiry$partition$current set status = '4' where stt_rec = @stt_rec
    update c15$000000 set status = '4' where stt_rec = @stt_rec
  end
end

Name: ScriptCurrency
Content:
<![CDATA[
  init: function(f) {
    this._currencyChangedHandler = Function.createDelegate(this, this.onCurrencyChanged);
    this._dateChangedHandler = Function.createDelegate(this, this.onDateChanged);
    this._currencySelectedHandler = Function.createDelegate(this, this.onCurrencySelected);
    f._currencyBehavior.addCurrencyHandler(this._currencyChangedHandler, this._dateChangedHandler, this._currencySelectedHandler);
  },
  dispose: function(f) {
    if (f._currencyBehavior) {
      if (this._currencyChangedHandler) {
        f._currencyBehavior.removeCurrencyHandler(this._currencyChangedHandler, this._dateChangedHandler, this._currencySelectedHandler);
        this._currencyChangedHandler = null;
        this._dateChangedHandler = null;
        this._currencySelectedHandler = null;
      }
      f._currencyBehavior.dispose();
    }
  },
]]>

}
function listView$ExecuteCommand(sender, e) {
  var action = e.type.Action;
  switch (action) {

      break;
    default:

  }
}

Content: --C--Controllers\Include\Command\HandleVoucherBookProcess.txt if @ma_nk = '' begin if exists (select 1 from v20dmctnk where ma_ct = @@id) begin declare @$emptyVoucherBook nvarchar(4000) select @$emptyVoucherBook = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Chưa nhập quyển chứng từ %s' else N'Empty book vouchers %s.' end select 'so_ct' as field, replace(@$emptyVoucherBook, '%s', replace(replace(replace(rtrim(''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')) as message return end end --endC-------------- declare @$msgVoucherBook nvarchar(4000) if @ma_nk <> '' begin if not exists(select 1 from v20dmnk where ma_nk = @ma_nk and ((@ngay_ct >= ngay_hl_tu or ngay_hl_tu is null) and (@ngay_ct <= ngay_hl_den or ngay_hl_den is null))) begin set @$msgVoucherBook = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Kiểm tra lại ngày hiệu lực của quyển chứng từ %s.' else N'Check the effective date of book vouchers %s.' end select 'so_ct' as field, replace(@$msgVoucherBook, '%s', replace(replace(replace(rtrim(@ma_nk), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')) as message return end select @$voucherBookUnit = ma_dvcs, @$voucherNumberType = m_trung_so, @$currentVoucherNumber = so_ct0, @$minVoucherNumber = so_ct1, @$maxVoucherNumber = so_ct2 from v20dmnk where ma_nk = @ma_nk end

VoucherWhenBeforeUpdateLogITTran
Content:
if @so_buoc <> 1 begin
  declare @$id$log varchar(32)
  select @$id$log = (left(@stt_rec, 10) + 'PNF')
  exec FastBusiness$App$Voucher$EditLog @$id$log, 'PNF', '$partition$previous', '1'
end

Name: HandleVoucherBookContext
Content:
if @ma_nk <> '' and exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_kt_quyen' and val = '1') begin
  declare @$strVoucherBook nvarchar(128)
  set @$strVoucherBook = replace(rtrim(@ma_nk), '''', '''''')
  select @$insertGrandField = @$insertGrandField + ', ma_nk',
    @$insertGrandValue = @$insertGrandValue + ', ''' + @$strVoucherBook + '''',
    @$checkKey = @$checkKey + case when @$checkKey <> '' then ' and ' else '' end + 'ma_nk = ''' + @$strVoucherBook + '''' + case when @$voucherBookUnit <> '' then ' and ma_dvcs = ''' + replace(@$voucherBookUnit, '''', '''''') + '''' else '' end,
    @$checkVoucherBook = @ma_nk
end
